description: Make a named Mohist Agent's saved execution definition the sole, snapshot-fixed source for direct AgentJobs and Workflow Agent task attempts.

tasks.title: Server: snapshot the Agent execution definition and remove named-Agent Runtime overrides
tasks.description: Create one Agent-owned resolved execution-definition value for Instructions, Runtime, Model, Variant, and ordered Skills. Use it for direct, mention, and routed Agent launches; persist it with append-only fields on AgentJob and routed plans, and retain it as immutable generic-AgentSession settings for later inputs and replacement bindings. Remove request and Issue/Routing Runtime override paths, reject a direct launch body containing runtime before creating state, and keep historical Issue values ignored without a data rewrite.
acceptanceCriteria: A direct, mention, and routed launch snapshot the active Agent's Instructions, Runtime, Model, Variant, and ordered Skills before runner offer; subsequent Agent edits do not affect the accepted job, routed redelivery, or generic Session settings
A new direct launch after an Agent edit uses the edited definition, while AgentJob recovery and reoffer use only persisted snapshot data
An Agent configured for pi opens a pi Session and produces a pi AgentJob dispatch even when Issue context contains a different historical Runtime
POST to the direct launch endpoint with runtime is rejected before an AgentSession or AgentJob exists; the launch contract and IAgentLauncher have no Runtime override parameter
Issue runtime override lookup, routing consumption, and Issue configuration write support are removed; persisted vars.agent.runtime values do not alter named-Agent launches
New Orleans fields are append-only and records lacking Skills or Runtime remain readable with empty Skills and the opencode default
Focused Server unit/spec tests use fakes and injected time, and dotnet build Mohist.sln plus the affected Server tests pass
tasks.output: Server-owned immutable Agent execution-definition snapshot used by every generic Agent launch, with named-Agent Runtime override paths removed.
tasks.notes: The AgentSession copy is immutable session-local execution context, not a writable second Agent definition. Preserve AgentJob and Session ownership boundaries.

tasks.title: Runner: deliver captured Skills and definition context to OpenCode and Pi
tasks.description: Extend the Mohist-owned OpenCode and Pi turn inputs with ordered Skills and implement one shared, data-delimited Skill preamble. AgentJob execution consumes only the persisted dispatch and generic Session-local definition; it applies Skills and Instructions to an initial or replacement physical binding, but sends an ordinary follow-up to an already established binding. Keep SDK calls inside the existing runtime deep modules.
acceptanceCriteria: An AgentJob dispatch carrying ordered Skills sends exactly those Skills, in order, to both selected Runtime request paths; an empty list adds neither Skills input nor preamble
The Skill preamble is deterministic and serializes skill names as data rather than executable prompt syntax
OpenCode and Pi AgentJob execution continue to select the snapshotted Runtime, model, and variant without rereading Agent state

A generic Session follow-up retains its Session-local definition, and the first input after Reset or confirmed-missing binding recovery reapplies Instructions and Skills only for the replacement binding
Missing installed Skill assets surface through the existing Runtime failure result instead of being silently dropped or preflighted by Server

Runner unit tests use fake Runtime implementations to cover ordered Skills, empty Skills, normal follow-up, replacement binding, and both Runtime paths; npm run typecheck and npm test -w packages/runner pass
tasks.output: OpenCode and Pi runtime turn paths that consume the immutable Agent definition and activate its ordered Skills for direct AgentJobs.
tasks.notes: Do not add a provider-specific Skill API, SDK DTO leak, Skill registry, or new Runner process.

tasks.title: Workflow: persist definition-complete mohist/agent task attempts
tasks.description: Extend the Agent read-side execution snapshot and WorkflowItemTranslator so mohist/agent resolves the active Agent into a fully transformed WorkDispatch: composed Instructions plus raw workflow prompt, resolved Runtime, Model, Variant, and Skills. Persist that envelope before offer, reoffer it verbatim, and create a fresh definition snapshot only on retry while preserving Workflow as the task and recovery authority.
acceptanceCriteria: A mohist/agent task for an active Agent dispatches through the Agent Runtime with the Agent's model, variant, and ordered Skills while keeping the raw workflow prompt as the task goal
The persisted WorkDispatch is reused unchanged after Agent edits, server restart, or grain activation; retry creates a new attempt using the then-current Agent definition
Workflow profile save and validation remain Agent-existence-independent and checks remain unsupported
A missing or archived Agent fails before Runner offer with TaskRun.Error.code equal to agent_not_found, without creating AgentJob or direct AgentSession state

Workflow translator and Server spec tests cover both OpenCode and Pi envelopes, snapshot reoffer, retry re-resolution, empty Skills, and structured resolution failure; npm test passes without real Runtime, network, process, filesystem, or wall-clock dependencies
tasks.output: Workflow-owned mohist/agent dispatch snapshots carrying the complete resolved execution definition and compatible with the Runner Skill input.
tasks.notes: Do not create an AgentJob or direct AgentSession from Workflow. The persisted WorkDispatch, not live Agent lookup, is the reoffer authority.

tasks.title: Web and documentation: expose Agent configuration as the only named-Agent execution control
tasks.description: Remove Issue-level Runtime controls and direct-launch override affordances for named Agents while retaining Runtime, Model, Variant, and Skills in the Agent profile editor. Update product and design documentation to state that client task/context input cannot override an Agent definition, that its Skills are fixed for the launch or task attempt, and that explicit Workflow Runtime Actions remain separate.
acceptanceCriteria: The Web has no Issue-level or direct-launch Runtime control that can alter a named Agent execution, while the Agent profile editor remains the Runtime, Model, Variant, and Skills configuration surface
Web client requests no longer write Issue vars.agent.runtime for named-Agent execution and handle the Server's removed override contract

docs/agents.md and docs/actions/agent.md describe the snapshot-fixed ownership and retry behavior without introducing Server or Runner implementation details; design gap notes reflect the landed behavior
Web tests cover the removed override control and retained Agent definition editor; npm run typecheck -w packages/web and npm run test:run -w packages/web pass
tasks.output: Web and documentation surfaces that present the Agent definition as the only execution-definition authority for named Agent work.
tasks.notes: Explicit mohist/opencode and mohist/pi Workflow Actions keep their existing uses-selected Runtime behavior.
